[[Knights of San Fernando]] |TV actor =[[Jacinto Taras Riddick]] }} '''Cleric Felix''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}. He is a member of the [[Brotherhood of Steel]] chapter known as the [[Knights of San Fernando]] in 2296. ==Background== It's unknown how or why Felix joined the Brotherhood of Steel; however, he had proven himself worthy to be raised into the ranks by becoming a [[Clerics|Cleric]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The End (episode)|The End]]=== Felix first appears during a class where he educates [[Aspirant (TV series)|aspirants]], such as [[Maximus]], about their purpose as members of the Brotherhood of Steel. That, of course, is to find and preserve [[Great War|pre-war]] [[technology]]. He asks Maximus to identify one such relic and strikes him as punishment for wrongly identifying it as a rotor instead of a circuit. His class is then interrupted by the arrival of [[the Prydwen]], as aspirants run out to gaze upon the airship. He is later seen conducting Maximus' anointment ceremony. There, he informs Maximus about his most sacred duties as a newly promoted squire, which include protecting the Brotherhood, its mission, and his new lord, Knight [[Titus]]. ==Personality== Felix is shown to be a strict and didactic person toward the aspirants he teaches and isn't against acting physically against them either, as shown by his interaction with Maximus. ==Notable quotes== * {{Inline quote|It is the duty of the Brotherhood of Steel to secure the Wasteland. One day as squires, you will help knights find and identify prewar tech.}} * {{Inline quote|The ability to defend yourself is but one part of your training. We are the finders and the preservers. Unless you know what to find and preserve, you are more useful as a corpse.}} * {{Inline quote|Aspirant Maximus. It is your most sacred duty to protect the Brotherhood. After which, it is your most sacred duty to protect the mission. After which, it is your most sacred duty to protect your lord Knight Titus. Do you accept?}} ==Appearances== Cleric Felix appears only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|1=101}} ==Gallery== FOTV BoS Base Classroom.png|Felix instructs aspirants FoTV Felix holding book.jpg|Felix testing Maximus FOTV S01E01 The End Cleric Felix 01.jpg|Rite of initiation for Maximus as a squire FOTV S01E01 The End Cleric Felix 02.jpg|Rite of initiation for Maximus as a squire {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[ru:Клирик Феликс]]
